P1.description: POST HOC, added after seeing the E4 results; not pre-registered and in no verdict. Held-out violation without the task confound: the E4 held-out regime as is, and the same with the benign training rows removed for every task that lost all its incidents to the hold-out; in-distribution training for reference. AUROC is given against all test benign and against test benign of the same tasks.

P2.description: POST HOC, added after seeing the E3 results; not pre-registered and in no verdict. Held-out mistakes within a seen route: realizations in every violation x route cell are split into groups A and B (sorted by name, alternating); a monitor trained on one group across all four routes is tested on the other group (held-out templates) and compared with the E3 all-four regime on the same test incidents (seen templates), with the same number of training incidents.
